title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Lantern Hill Cardiology under your Medicare Advantage plan for services provided on August 26, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Reason for denial: The provider is not in your plan's network. Your plan does not cover services from out-of-network providers except in an emergency. Reason code: CO-242.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $1,394.35 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $1,394.35.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Larkspur Benefit Administrators, Appeals Unit, PO Box 79944, Austin, TX 78701. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-6210.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
